description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Goblin Taskmaster, adding {R}.
When Goblin Taskmaster dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Goblin Taskmaster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Goblin Taskmaster's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
